_note: lambda is retuned each cycle so that ESS(lambda) hits the target, using log w(lambda) = -J/lambda - C + log q with J the state cost and C the lambda-free part of the control term, so the temperature stays consistent in the cost and in the weights. ess_target_met_mean is the fraction of cycles where the target was reachable at all: as lambda grows the weights tend to softmax(log q - C), whose ESS is a ceiling the temperature cannot raise.
